title: 2501. Longest Square Streak in an Array

examples.explanation: Choose the subsequence [4,16,2]. After sorting it, it becomes [2,4,16]. - 4 = 2 * 2. - 16 = 4 * 4. Therefore, [4,16,2] is a square streak. It can be shown that every subsequence of length 4 is not a square streak.
There is no square streak in nums so return -1.
